sources.snippet: Overview wav2vec2-xls-r-300m is facebook's 300-million-parameter multilingual speech representation model built on the wav2vec 2.0 architecture. The model undergoes pretraining on 436,000 hours of unlabeled speech across 128 languages using datasets including VoxPopuli, MLS, CommonVoice, BABEL, and VoxLingua107.
